zh.title: 台灣高鐵N700ST新車在日本福岡舉行出廠晚宴
zh.summary: 台灣高鐵2026年7月29日晚間在日本福岡舉行N700ST新型車輛出廠歡迎晚宴，活動由台灣高鐵董事長史哲主持，交通部長陳世凱代表最大股東出席。會中史哲宣布高鐵董事會捐贈2000萬日圓協助熊本地震賑災，台日政界及軌道產業代表約300人共同與會。
body: 台灣高鐵公司於2026年7月29日晚間在日本福岡舉行「台灣高鐵N700ST新型車輛出廠」歡迎晚宴，慶祝新型軌道車輛順利出廠。活動由台灣高鐵公司董事長史哲主持，交通部長陳世凱則代表最大股東出席晚宴。
本次活動吸引台日政界與軌道產業約300人參與，包含駐日代表李逸洋、多位跨黨派國會議員，以及JR東海會長金子慎與日立軌道事業執行長馬里諾等人。台灣高鐵董事長史哲並於會中宣布，高鐵董事會已決定捐贈2000萬日圓協助熊本地震災後支援。

en.title: Taiwan High Speed Rail Holds Rollout Ceremony Dinner for N700ST Trains in Fukuoka
en.summary: Taiwan High Speed Rail held a welcome dinner in Fukuoka, Japan, on July 29, 2026, to mark the rollout of its new N700ST trains. The event was hosted by Taiwan High Speed Rail Chairman Shi Che, with Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih-kai attending on behalf of the company's largest shareholder. During the event, Shi Che announced that the board of directors decided to donate 20 million yen for Kumamoto earthquake relief. Around 300 participants from Taiwanese and Japanese political and rail industry sectors attended.
body: Taiwan High Speed Rail hosted a welcome dinner in Fukuoka, Japan, on July 29, 2026, to mark the factory rollout of its new N700ST trains. The ceremony was presided over by Taiwan High Speed Rail Chairman Shi Che, with Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih-kai attending on behalf of the high-speed rail operator's largest shareholder.

The event brought together approximately 300 guests from Taiwanese and Japanese political and industrial sectors, including Representative to Japan Lee I-yang, lawmakers from both countries, JR Central Chairman Shin Kaneko, and Hitachi Rail CEO Giuseppe Marino. During the event, Shi Che announced that the board of directors of Taiwan High Speed Rail decided to donate 20 million yen for Kumamoto earthquake relief effort.
